hardware.name: computer
hardware.basis: 65x30 mm manufacturer PCB footprint; 8 mm raw assembly thickness assumed. 22x85x50 mm installed box includes provisional cooling, plugs and standoffs; connector-specific CAD and thermal test required.

hardware.name: battery
hardware.basis: No battery SKU selected. 70x35x22 mm maximum pack requirement, installed flat across the low front chest to counterbalance rear electronics and tail and clear the moving jaw; 80x43x30 mm installed allowance includes restraint, insulation and lead exit. Removable through lower service panel after disconnecting power.

hardware.name: u2d2
hardware.basis: Manufacturer 48x18x14.9 mm body, rotated into left rear bay; 60x25x20 mm installed allowance for plugs. Check USB-C vs older Micro-B revision before cable purchase.

hardware.name: motor_regulator
hardware.basis: D24V90F5 manufacturer board dimensions without optional terminals; 50x30x15 mm installed allowance, soldered low-profile leads. Rated current is input/thermal dependent; enclosure operation is not qualified.

hardware.name: logic_regulator
hardware.basis: D24V22F5 manufacturer dimensions without headers; 25x25x12 mm installation allowance.

hardware.name: power_distribution
hardware.basis: Unselected fuse, cutoff, split motor/logic power and distribution assembly. Raw and installed boxes are procurement requirements, not vendor dimensions.

hardware.name: body_imu
hardware.basis: ISM330DHCX breakout 25.4x17.78 mm board outline; 4.5 mm assembly thickness assumed. 30x25x8 mm installed reserve with low-profile STEMMA leads; no upright headers.

hardware.name: character_electronics
hardware.basis: Unselected small LED/audio/button assembly; its dimensions and 10 g mass are allowances.

hardware.name: harness_trunk
hardware.basis: 35 g whole-robot harness allocation represented at rear trunk COM; box is a reserved gathering corridor, not a solid block or complete cable route. Branch routes, plug retention and moving-joint service loops remain provisional.

hardware.name: head_imu
hardware.basis: Same breakout and installation assumptions as body IMU; moved forward to clear jaw servo.

hardware.name: camera
hardware.basis: Camera Module 2 mechanical reference: manufacturer 25x24x9 mm, 3 g bare. 17x30x29 mm installed reserve and 8 g installed mass are allowances. Radxa documents Camera V2 support; selected cable routing, overlay operation in this robot, and the optical shell opening are unqualified. This is a physical camera reservation, not an enabled vision pipeline.

torso_outer_loft.basis: Exact 20-column torso outer profile and triangle diagonals, with intentional apertures capped for enclosure only.

skull_outer_loft.basis: Actual closed polygonal skull loft before underside and lens-aperture openings.

exterior_containment.scope: Whole installation boxes inside the closed exterior reference; physical wall gaps are independently checked.
limitations: Reference caps establish exterior containment, not a fabricated closure over intentional joint and service openings.
Installed boxes must separately clear actual wall material and mechanisms by the declared clearance margin.

omissions: Installation boxes are engineering allowances and require selected connector/cable CAD and hardware measurement.
Raw XL330 cases retain the full 20x34x26 mm dimensions; horns/idlers, bearings and shaft interfaces remain baseline approximations.
Air space does not demonstrate passive cooling, fan airflow or full simultaneous servo-load capability.
Service corridors are removal proposals; they require panel openings and independent service-pose verification.
Camera mass is an additional 8 g allowance; ribbon routing, on-robot operation and a clear optical aperture are not certified.
Appearance meshes represent concept geometry; skull walls model 1.2 mm nominal thickness, while fastening, ventilation and manufacturing CAD remain unqualified.
Skull and jaw replacement retain their existing assigned masses; new neck/leg/toe covers add explicit 12 g allowances.
Motor centers, joint axes/ranges, actuator settings and original sole collision footprints are unchanged by appearance generation.
A real 12 mm nose aperture clears the camera optical axis; the actual lens field of view, window material, ribbon bends and lens-to-window mount remain unqualified.
Body-local box inertia surrogates are used for small new covers, with explicit assigned mass rather than inferred material density.
Rear cap, panel flanges, fasteners and internal mounting frame are allocated in mass but need fabrication CAD.
The hip, shoulder and yaw apertures are open; joint covers must remain separate moving parts.
